description: This file provides internationalization (i18n) translations for the Select2 plugin in the Basque language ('eu'). It defines messages for input validation, loading, and selection limits.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has entered too many characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more characters need to be entered.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message displayed while more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message when no search results match.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message shown during a search operation.
